ShortDescription.Value: Preview and export your city's metro map. / 预览并导出城市地铁线路图。

Publish.LongDescription:
Turn the metro/subway network of your Cities: Skylines II city into a clean, readable metro map.
The current release includes a read-only in-game preview. Open the metro-map button in the top-right toolbar to inspect the current city, refresh it, switch between geographic and schematic views, filter labels, zoom/pan, export JSON, or save the current SVG without leaving the game.
For the most complete official-style schematic map, export your city's metro network to JSON and open it in the free companion Windows Viewer. The Viewer can save SVG, PNG, or PDF for wallpapers, posters, printing, and sharing.
The companion Windows Viewer is released separately on GitHub and is now at v0.1.1. Its version may be newer than the in-game Mod because Viewer-only updates do not require a duplicate Paradox Mods upload.
How to use: 1. Load a city and click the metro-map button in the top-right toolbar for the in-game preview. 2. In Options > CS2 Metro Diagram, choose Auto / English / Simplified Chinese and an export folder. 3. Export JSON, then open the Viewer and click "Open Default Export" for the full schematic workflow. 4. Adjust the layout/size if you like, then save as SVG, PNG, or PDF.
The default map layout draws lines horizontal, vertical, or 45-degree, renders lines that share a track as parallel lines, and fills the canvas — the same conventions real metro maps use.
Download the Viewer and full source from GitHub: https://github.com/Eriksas/Cities-Skylines-2-Metro-Viewer
Viewer download mirror (Baidu Netdisk) / Viewer 下载（百度网盘）: https://pan.baidu.com/s/5RspPYzFb0dPoOE0aZu7d4A
Does your city's map not look quite right? Share your metro-export.json in a GitHub issue and the next version will be tuned against YOUR city. 觉得你的城市图排得不够好？把 metro-export.json 发到 GitHub issue，下个版本就拿你的城市调优。
Current limitations: - Metro/subway only. - Preview/export only; it never edits your city. - The desktop Viewer remains recommended for manual layout editing and PNG/PDF export.
中文简介： 把《城市：天际线 II》城市中的地铁网络转换为清晰、易读的地铁线路图。
当前版本提供只读的游戏内预览。点击右上角工具栏中的地铁线路图按钮，即可查看当前城市，刷新数据，在地理图与示意图之间切换，筛选站名，缩放或拖动画布，导出 JSON，或直接保存当前 SVG。模组只读取并导出交通数据，不会修改城市、线路或存档。
如需更完整的官方风格示意图、手动调整以及 PNG/PDF 导出，请把 JSON 导入免费的 Windows 桌面 Viewer。Viewer 与游戏内模组分别发布，因此版本号可能不同；当前桌面 Viewer 为 v0.1.1。
使用方法： 1. 进入城市，点击右上角的地铁线路图按钮打开游戏内预览。 2. 在“选项 > CS2 地铁线路图”中选择自动、English 或简体中文，并设置导出文件夹。 3. 点击导出 JSON，然后在桌面 Viewer 中使用“打开默认导出”载入线路网。 4. 按需调整布局和尺寸，再保存为 SVG、PNG 或 PDF。
Viewer 与完整源代码： https://github.com/Eriksas/Cities-Skylines-2-Metro-Viewer
Viewer 百度网盘下载： https://pan.baidu.com/s/5RspPYzFb0dPoOE0aZu7d4A
当前限制： - 目前仅支持地铁 / Subway。 - 游戏内功能只负责预览和导出，不会编辑城市数据。 - 手动排版与 PNG/PDF 导出仍推荐使用桌面 Viewer。
Publish.ChangeLog: 0.1.0 - first stable in-game release: - Promoted the owner-validated read-only in-game metro preview and export workflow to stable. - Improved the in-game schematic with deterministic horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree route alignment, rounded corners, density relief, station straight-runs, and shared-corridor lane handling. - Geographic view remains the faithful default and fallback; its route geometry is unchanged by the schematic polish. - Preserved the JSON export schema and read-only city behavior. - Includes the beta.8 fix that gives auto-named metro lines their real numbered names.
